title: Non-anchor position period prediction
rationale: Test whether a predeclared position-period rule predicts held-out K4 position classes before any key-material expansion or fragment-score tuning.
prediction_target: Before scoring any candidate words, choose one period from {2,3,4,5,7,8,13} using only the predeclared rule, then predict which non-anchor K4 position residues should share the same derived key-value class.
discovery_inputs: Residue classes selected before observing new score output
evaluation_inputs: Withheld non-anchor K4 position residue classes
Future source-documented fragment rows, if independently obtained
